delta_x.description: Horizontal wheel distance in CSS pixels. Positive values move right.

delta_y.description: Vertical wheel distance in CSS pixels. Positive values move down.

ref.description: Optional `@e<N>` ref used as the wheel event's hit-test point. Mutually exclusive with `selector`. When neither is supplied, the event is dispatched at the viewport centre.

tab_id.description: Target tab. Defaults to the Agent Window's active tab.

KeyModifier.description: Keyboard modifier flags. Multiple flags may be combined; the extension folds them into CDP's bitfield (`alt=1, ctrl=2, meta=4, shift=8`).
